title: Experiment Lab và Performance Coach
scope_items: Acceptance Target 1 (Low exposure → inconclusive): Implemented canonical exposure bounds (<1,000 impressions/views per variant, <48h duration, zero views, or missing denominator) in Go, Web, and Mobile. Experiments evaluated below threshold yield status='completed', result_status='inconclusive', winner_asset_id='' (or null), confidence_level=0.0, is_observational=true, and automated winner scaling is blocked.

Acceptance Target 2 (Observational label retained): Organic comparisons, coaching insights, scorecards, and conclusive experiment winners retain is_observational=true with standard notice ('Observational recommendation - not causal proof or guaranteed revenue uplift.') across Go, Web (W027), and Mobile (M039).

Acceptance Target 3 (Scaling rechecks M11 gates): Automated scaling of conclusive experiment winners rechecks all four fresh M11 gates: Gate 1 Permission (publish:execute / Editor+), Gate 2 Platform Capability (connector active and supported), Gate 3 Policy Compliance (Packaging QA scan free of hard blocks), Gate 4 Duplicate-post cooldown (24h cooldown window). Rechecked and verified across Go, Web, and Mobile.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestABExperiment_AcceptanceTarget1_LowExposureInconclusive in Go, Web Vitest, and Flutter test suite confirm low exposure yields completed/inconclusive with empty winner and retained observational flag.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestPerformanceCoach_AcceptanceTarget2_ObservationalLabelRetained in Go, Web Vitest, and Flutter test suite confirm all coaching scorecards, benchmark comparisons, and conclusive experiment winners strictly maintain is_observational=true and the canonical observational notice.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestABExperiment_AcceptanceTarget3_ScalingRechecksM11Gates in Go, Web Vitest, and Flutter test suite confirm independent enforcement of all 4 scaling gates (permission, capability, policy, cooldown).

Screen Implementation Verified: Web Screen W027 (Studio A/B Testing Engine at /studio/ab-test) and Mobile Screen M039 (Performance Coach View at /analytics/coach) implemented with exact wireframes, observational badges, scorecards, and interactive controls.

Full CI Quality Gates Verified: check_d0.sh (PASS), check_proto.sh (PASS with 0 breaking changes against origin/main), check_go.sh (PASS with race detector, gofmt, go vet, govulncheck 0 vulnerabilities, fail-closed entrypoints), check_node.sh (PASS with svelte-check 0 warnings/0 errors, vite build, vitest 31 test files / 250 tests passed, real SSR smoke), and check_flutter.sh (PASS with flutter analyze 0 issues, 212 tests passed).
external_gates: Native TikTok/Instagram/YouTube insight metrics and conversion tracking APIs require verified production app review; evaluated via domain models and bounded fixtures.
PostgreSQL schema §22.9 ab_test_experiments JSONB fields, variants, criteria, and composite keys verified in local test suite; multi-tenant live database verification executes in CI.
